svg.title: A hundredfold larger start and a doubled rate halve the waiting time.
svg.desc: Schematic logistic solutions for product u = ab with target s = 1. Baseline: tau = 1, u0 = 0.0001. A 100 times larger start: tau = 1, u0 = 0.01. A 2 times faster rate: tau = 0.5, u0 = 0.0001. They reach u = 0.5 at about 9.21, 4.60 and 4.61 respectively; the faster-rate curve rises more steeply than the larger-start curve. These are analytic illustrations, not training measurements.
